scope.description: Bounded constituent of the exact same five aligned core units of the Anaphora of the Twelve Apostles (printed inline in the Ordo Communis under running head 'ܡܢ ܢܐܦܘܪ ܐܠܬܠܡܝܕܗ ܐܠܬܢܐܥܫܪܝܗ') in Classical Syriac (syr), located in retained Part 2 (pages-0224-0447-5b0fbb00, PDF 127, 125-122; reversed RTL scan order), enabling a direct 1594 vs 1908 Maronite visual diff.
omitted_book_divisions: Companion split PDF pages-0001-0223-07f785ad (223 pp.: Good Friday Presanctified, back anaphoras, calendar/computus table at whole-PDF 8)
Remainder of Part 2 after Twelve Apostles Epiclesis (Part 2 PDF 1-121: diptychs, fraction, communion, Roman Church and subsequent anaphoras)

Intervening Preface/Post-Sanctus (Part 2 PDF 126), intervening rubricated Trinitarian cross-blessing on PDF 127, red Garshuni rubrics, parallel Garshuni columns, Anamnesis (Part 2 PDF 123), secret Epiclesis preamble and closing fruits paragraph (Part 2 PDF 123 bottom, 122 top/bottom)
Pre-anaphoral Ordo Communis and native Syriac/Arabic title leaf at Part 2 PDF 218 / whole-PDF 441 (Part 2 PDF 128-224)

sources.rights_basis: Faithful bounded reading transcription of original-language liturgical text from Ketābā de-qurbānā (Beirut Maronite Press, 1908 second printing of Dibs 1888) — Anaphora of the Twelve Apostles Core, whose United States copyright term has expired by publication date (1908 (second printing of Dibs 1888)). Derived directly from tracked public-domain facsimile artifact.maronite-church.qurbono.1908-beirut-maronite-press-second-printing.pages-0224-0447-5b0fbb00 without modern translation or editorial reconstruction. Third-party historical text is excluded from Triptych's CC BY 4.0 license.
sources.transformation: Pure consonantal Classical Syriac Unicode (U+0710..U+072C, UTF-8 NFC) with single ASCII spaces between words and single LF (\n) line endings, one canonical liturgical unit per line.; All West Syriac vowel points, seyame (U+0308), qushshaya/rukkakha, punctuation marks, liturgical crosses (including inline red crosses splitting ܘܒܪܟ in 1594), kashidas, catchwords, running heads, border ornaments, and page numbers are omitted for scan-safe cross-edition diffing.; Rubrics (red Syriac or red Garshuni stage directions), speaker labels (priest/deacon/people), editorial 'etc.' cues (ܘܫܪ), intervening rubricated Trinitarian cross-blessings, and parallel Garshuni/Arabic columns are excluded.; Printed historical orthography (such as ܐܪܙܐ in 1594 vs ܪܐܙܐ in 1908, and ܒܐܝܕܝܐ in both Chalice preambles), abbreviations (such as abbreviated Dialogue incipits in 1594), omissions, and additions are preserved verbatim without harmonizing or supplying words from memory.

units.text: ܚܘܒܐ ܕܝܢ ܕܐܠܗܐ ܐܒܐ ܛܝܒܘܬܐ ܕܝܢ ܕܝܚܝܕܝܐ ܒܪܐ ܫܘܬܦܘܬܐ ܘܡܓܢܢܘܬܐ ܕܪܘܚܐ ܕܩܘܕܫܐ ܬܗܘܐ ܥܡ ܟܠܟܘܢ ܐܚܝ ܠܥܠܡܝܢ ܘܥܡ ܪܘܚܐ ܕܝܠܟ ܠܥܠ ܢܗܘܘܢ ܗܘܢܐ ܘܡܕܥܐ ܘܠܒܘܬܐ ܕܟܠܢ ܐܝܬܝܗܘܢ ܠܘܬܟ ܡܪܝܐ ܢܘܕܐ ܠܡܪܝܐ ܒܕܚܠܬܐ ܘܢܣܓܘܕ ܠܗ ܒܪܬܝܬܐ ܫܘܐ ܘܙܕܩ
ܒܝܘܡܐ ܗܘ ܕܩܕܡ ܚܫܐ ܕܝܠܗ ܢܣܒ ܠܠܚܡܐ ܒܐܝܕܘܗܝ ܩܕܝܫܬܐ ܘܐܪܝܡ ܥܝܢܘܗܝ ܠܘܬܟ ܐܠܗܐ ܐܒܘܗܝ ܐܚܝܕ ܟܠ ܘܐܘܕܝ ܠܟ ܘܒܪܟ ܘܩܕܫ ܘܩܨܐ ܘܝܗܒ ܠܬܠܡܝܕܘܗܝ ܟܕ ܐܡܪ ܣܒܘ ܐܟܘܠܘ ܡܢܗ ܟܠܟܘܢ ܗܢܐ ܕܝܢ ܐܝܬܘܗܝ ܦܓܪܐ ܕܝܠܝ ܐܡܝܢ

ܒܗ ܕܝܢ ܒܙܢܐ ܡܢ ܒܬܪ ܕܐܚܫܡܘ ܢܣܒ ܒܐܝܕܝܐ ܕܝܠܗ ܩܕܝܫܬܐ ܟܣܐ ܗܢܐ ܕܚܡܪܐ ܘܐܘܕܝ ܠܟ ܘܒܪܟ ܘܩܕܫ ܘܝܗܒ ܠܬܠܡܝܕܘܗܝ ܟܕ ܐܡܪ ܣܒܘ ܐܫܬܘ ܡܢܗ ܟܠܟܘܢ ܗܢܐ ܕܝܢ ܐܝܬܘܗܝ ܟܣܐ ܕܕܡܝ ܕܕܝܬܝܩܝ ܚܕܬܐ ܕܠܥܠܡ ܪܐܙܐ ܗܘ ܕܗܝܡܢܘܬܐ ܕܚܠܦܝܟܘܢ ܘܚܠܦ ܣܓܝܐܐ ܡܬܐܫܕ ܠܫܘܒܩܢܐ ܕܚܛܗܐ ܐܡܝܢ
ܥܢܝܢܝ ܡܪܝܐ ܥܢܝܢܝ ܡܪܝܐ ܥܢܝܢܝ ܡܪܝܐ ܘܢܐܬܐ ܡܪܝ ܪܘܚܟ ܚܝܐ ܘܩܕܝܫܐ ܘܢܫܪܐ ܥܠܝ ܘܥܠ ܩܘܪܒܢܐ ܗܢܐ ܩܘܪܝܐܠܝܣܘܢ
ܘܠܪܐܙܐ ܗܢܐ ܦܓܪܐ ܕܡܫܝܚܐ ܐܠܗܐ ܕܝܠܢ ܢܥܒܕ ܕܢܗܘܐ ܠܦܘܪܩܢܐ ܕܝܠܢ ܐܡܝܢ ܘܠܟܣܐ ܗܢܐ ܕܡܐ ܕܡܫܝܚܐ ܐܠܗܐ ܕܝܠܢ ܢܥܒܕ ܕܢܗܘܐ ܠܦܘܪܩܢܐ ܕܝܠܢ ܐܡܝܢ
